description: Row count check: validate JSON row lists in an Airflow Variable (post-ETL) — minimum row count, required non-null keys, and unique keys.

source_variable.description: Airflow Variable containing a JSON array of row objects from an upstream ETL step
source_variable.title: Source Variable

min_rows.description: Require at least this many rows in the JSON array
min_rows.title: Min Rows

not_null_keys.description: Object keys that must be present and non-null in every row
not_null_keys.title: Not Null Keys

unique_keys.description: Object keys whose values must be unique across rows (e.g. period bucket)
unique_keys.title: Unique Keys

title: Row count check
